Aisha (People Ops): Hey folks — we're rolling out a lighter manager playbook for growth milestones and self-review prompts. Can people share 1-2 lines that are easy to paste into a 1:1 or self-review?
Marco (Eng Mgr): Love this. Need copy I can paste into calendar invites + a 3-bullet check-in script.
Priya (IC): Short checklist I can use before my self-review: impact, learnings, blockers.
Darren (People Ops): Drafting a compact bundle — manager intro, 3 milestone templates, and self-review starter lines. Sharing below as paste-ready snippets. Feedback welcome.
Darren (People Ops): Manager intro (paste):
```
Hi — quick goal check: 1) What progress did you make toward this milestone? 2) What helped or slowed you down? 3) One action for next week.
Approx time: 10m. Bring evidence/artifacts if you can.
```
Lena (Manager): Nice. Can we have one variant for career growth vs delivery goals?
Darren (People Ops): Yep — two short milestone templates:
Career growth (paste):
```
Milestone: Lead a cross-team design review by Q2
Success signals: ran agenda, collected decisions, two follow-up actions assigned
Support needed: mentorship on stakeholder ops + 2 rehearsal sessions
```
Delivery goal (paste):
```
Milestone: Reduce avg inference latency by 20% on the production model
Success signals: baseline metrics, benchmark tests, and a deploy with no regression alerts
Support needed: access to perf cluster + code review from infra 2x/week
```
Priya (IC): Love the brevity. For self-review starter lines:
```
- Achievement (1-2 sentences): what I shipped and the customer/metric impact
- Learning: one skill or decision I improved
- Next step: two small experiments or tasks for next cycle
```
hr-bot: Reminder: performance calibration window opens 2026-04-01. Please finish manager check-ins 2 weeks before. :calendar:
Kate (Director): Add one manager coaching prompt that surfaces growth appetite: "What stretch would you take if you had full support?"
Darren (People Ops): Good one — adding to the template set. Also adding a 1-line rubric for managers to use quickly:
```
Rubric (1-line): Exceeds = delivered + mentored others; Meets = delivered with measurable impact; Developing = partially delivered, clear blockers; Needs Support = not delivered + unclear plan
```
Marco (Eng Mgr): Can you also make one quick calendar blurb (30-40 chars) I can drop into invites?
Darren (People Ops): Calendar blurb: "10m goal check — progress, blockers, next step"
Lena (Manager): I'm saving these to my 1:1 template doc. Anything we should avoid wording-wise?
Darren (People Ops): Avoid vague absolutes like "did everything" or solely qualitative claims. Encourage evidence and a concrete next action.
Aisha (People Ops): This is great — final ask: can we get a one-paragraph guide for ICs about how to use milestones in a self-review?
Priya (IC): Quick draft: "Use milestones to show progress and learning. For each milestone, state the outcome, the evidence (link or metric), one thing you learned, and a concrete next step. Keep each item under 3 lines."
Kate (Director): Perfect. Thanks everyone — can People Ops bundle these into a single snippet pack we can ship with the review calendar?
Darren (People Ops): Will do. I'll post a ZIP of the snippets + copy for managers by tomorrow and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
